description: #22228: while the last word is typed the token keeps the incomplete-word dot ('main.'), SpatialSearchRanking.queriedWords passed it to the name comparison and the airport lost its exact-name bonus: on the real map it fell to #6, behind the city 'Frankfurt am Main' in the district 'Flughafen', the Luftbrückendenkmal and the station Gateway Gardens. The extract holds the objects of the first 100 spatial results for the airport queries on Germany_hessen_darmstadt (2026-09 map) with their travel_elo (airport 1269, memorial 2310, Gateway Gardens 1112) and the BOUNDARY 'Flughafen', which makes the city+district combination win.
